_comment_version: Manifest V3 — strict compliance. No background pages, only service workers.
name: FinEngine-Wasm
description: Privacy-first smart budget manager. All computation and encryption happen locally via WebAssembly. Zero cloud dependency.
_comment_icons: Provide all four sizes for proper rendering across Chrome surfaces.
_comment_action: Defines the popup. default_popup is the entry point for the budget UI.
_comment_background: MV3 uses a service worker, NOT a persistent background page. The Wasm module is loaded inside this worker.
_comment_content_scripts: matches: target e-commerce and billing sites for DOM price detection.
run_at: document_idle ensures DOM is fully parsed before scanning.
world: ISOLATED (default) — content script runs in isolated JS context, not page's context.
Expand 'matches' as additional site integrations are added.
_comment_permissions: storage: Required for chrome.storage.local (encrypted blob persistence).
alarms: Required for periodic burn-rate recalculation in the service worker.
activeTab: Required only when user explicitly invokes the popup — does NOT grant persistent tab access.
_comment_host_permissions: None declared here — content script host access is handled via 'matches' above.
We do NOT request broad host permissions. Principle of least privilege.
_comment_options: Full-page settings panel for salary input, rule configuration, and category management.
_comment_web_accessible_resources: The Wasm binary and its JS glue code must be web-accessible so they can be loaded
by the popup and service worker contexts. Restrict access to extension origin only.
SECURITY NOTE: 'matches' is set to the extension's own origin — not '<all_urls>'.
_comment_content_security_policy: MV3 enforces strict CSP automatically. We explicitly harden it further.
wasm-unsafe-eval: Required by Chrome to instantiate .wasm binaries in MV3.
No 'unsafe-inline', no remote scripts, no eval() in JS.
Tailwind is loaded via a compiled local CSS file — no CDN runtime scripts.
